neet_phy_u20_t13_1.working: At minimum deviation i = e and r1 = r2 = A/2. The ray inside the prism therefore travels parallel to the base.

neet_phy_u20_t13_3.working: δ = i + e − A = 55 + 45 − 60 = 40°. By reversibility of light, incidence at 45° gives emergence at 55° and the same deviation.

neet_phy_u20_t13_4.working: i + e = A + δ (II); r1 + r2 = A (I); r1 at minimum deviation = A/2 (III); δ = i + e − A (IV).

neet_phy_u20_t13_5.working: A is false because the δ-i curve is not symmetric. B is true. C is true because violet has a higher refractive index. D is standard lab practice. E is false because each deviation above δm occurs at two angles of incidence. So B, C and D are correct.
